content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Collins

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma—and ensure your project hours meet the standard. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify eligibility questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP prep course, delivered online nationwide. The structured curriculum covers all domains of the PMBOK® Guide and integrates real-world scenarios relevant to Fort Collins's technology, manufacturing, and energy sectors. You'll complete the full contact-hour requirement on a schedule that fits your work calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, you'll submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely approval. Once PMI verifies your eligibility, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers exam-preparation resources and practice testing to reinforce key concepts before exam day. You'll take the computer-based PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging topics as you finalize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Over Three Years
steps_items.text: Once certified, you'll earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP® active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible learning opportunities, webinars, and resources to support your continuous professional development and career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
